method: Source-painted cloth mesh with separate head lean, body inflation, hem ripple and hem-anchored collapse. A small translucent breath puff travels left. Original holes and cloth folds are retained. Disconnected alpha speckles removed in derivative only.

actions.idle: Small buoyant bob with independent hem motion; head leans left.
actions.attack: Inflate and rise in anticipation, lean left for a tiny boo, release a leftward breath puff, flutter and recover.
actions.hurt: Recoil right, briefly compress the cloth, shake the hem and recover.
actions.defeat: Invisible form collapses; the sheet sinks from its head to a flat folded cloth at the original hem, then stays down.

orientation.method: Unlettered source cloth is reflected, its head leans left, and the boo gesture and breath move left; recoil goes right and recovery returns left.
